result:
All 14 queries ran and gave sensible answers. I also checked the T1, T4, T11, T12 and T13 results by hand against the input files.

In T10, the map keys print as keywords (`:db`), because every map key in qlang is a keyword.

The answers were:
- T1: 4
- T2: ["alice","carol","erin","ivan"]
- T3: {US: 3, DE: 2, unknown: 2, FR: 2}
- T4: 33.17
- T5: ["bug","feature","performance","tests","urgent"]
- T6: 106 (carol), 102 (null), 108 (null)
- T7: {alice: 3, bob: 1}
- T8: ["eslint@^8.56.0","express@^4.18.2","jest@^29.7.0","typescript@^5.3.3","zod@^3.22.0"]
- T9: "auth,reports,search"
- T10: {db: 3, api: 1, worker: 1}
- T11: 330.2
- T12: 204.91
- T13: Birch 109.97, then Acme 104.96
- T14: "elderberry-banana-cherry-apple-date-kiwi-fig"

T1: /data/users | filter ~(/active) | filter ~(at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com") | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) * /name
T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") * count
T4: /data/users * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2
T5: | filter ~(/state | eq "open") * (/labels * (/name | lower)) | flat | distinct | sort
T6: | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * {:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce null | if (eq null) ~(null) ~(/login))}
T7: | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) * count
T8: | unionOf /dependencies /devDependencies | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) * ([(/0 | keyword) /1] | join "@")
T9: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | filter ~(/port | gt 8000) * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (trim | split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2) * count
T11: lines * (trim | split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=")) | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (/0 | drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * split "," | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | filter ~(/5 | lower | eq "shipped") * mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson) | sum | round 2
T13: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * split "," | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | filter ~(/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~(/1) * (* mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson) | sum) | entries * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total (/1 | round 2)} | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2
T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
